top_signals.title: AI may change the price of your Big Mac and groceries — what this means for shoppers
top_signals.summary: As retailers turn to AI tools to streamline operations, experts warn that collecting more detailed consumer data increases the risk of personalized pricing.

top_signals.title: Bookmarked: Stories That Caught Our Eye This Week
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo are on Bloomberg This Weekend for “Bookmarked,” sharing stories that caught their attention over the past week. The hosts discuss the reporting that piqued their interest and explain why those stories stood out from the week’s news. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: FBI arrests another suspected ShinyHunters hacker after agency breach
top_signals.summary: The FBI has arrested another suspected member of the ShinyHunters extortion group believed to be involved in the recent breach of FBI systems, Director Kash Patel announced Friday. [...]
